decisions.reason: The award-winning hipress geothermal probe builds directly on the firm's core plastic pipe and geothermal know-how, and the recognition confirms the firm can interpret and leverage its market value.
The single-U borehole heat exchanger is a standard extension of the firm's established geothermal plastics range, so it fits existing absorptive capacity and production competence.
The surface technology for geothermal probes draws on in-house materials expertise and complements the probe portfolio, making it easy to assimilate and refine.
Fire-protection steel profiles are close to the firm's core steel systems business, where deep knowledge and regulatory certification investments favor continuation.
Slim steel profile systems are a core competence in Jansen's building systems, so the firm can readily learn from customer feedback and keep improving them.
Decorative surfaces on steel profiles build on established profile and finishing know-how and add customized architectural value aligned with the firm's strategy.
